items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: He was called Chief Somebody. I forget his name. He was on the show.

ctx.x: Oh, he was. I knew him in Chicago, out west.

He left us in Pickway, Ohio. He was on the show. And we had another guy with a bicycle act. He used to take the bicycle, just ride one wheel and all that kind of stuff. He was called Chief Somebody. I forget his name. He was on the show. Yeah, chorus girls we had with my wife in... Oh, one, two, three, four. We had about four or five girls from here in the Walnut. On the show.

Well, I think I would keep changing the subject maybe, but since you, I know, sing so well and do a lot of singing with George Lewis' band, did you ever sing in any of those shows? Oh yeah, I used to sing. You would sing too?
